definitions.explanation: Money, especially in financial, economic, or compound contexts; a loanword that sounds more modern or technical than お{金|かね}.

examples.japanese: {電子|でんし}マネー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
マネー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{動|うご}かす→動かす：01885_ugokasu⟧。
examples.english: The flow of money drives the economy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{電子|でんし}マネー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Lately more people shop using electronic money on their smartphones.

notes:
A loanword from English for money. Everyday cash is usually ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧; マネー appears mainly in compounds and in finance or economics contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電子|でんし}マネー: electronic money
- マネーロンダリング: money laundering
- マネー⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧: the money market

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧: money — the ordinary everyday word
- ⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧: cash — physical notes and coins
